label: spokesperson for
definition: Person X serves or served as spokesperson for principal Y, which may be a person, organization or public office.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit spokesman/spokeswoman/spokesperson; expressly speaking for principal; representation through an identified principal office. Excludes: director/president/adviser/aide/lobbyist/secretary alone; communicating to rather than for Y; forward principal-to-person direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: geographic dateline replacing the person; unclear represented principal.

facts.reason: Richard N. Perle → Pentagon: Adviser, secretary, consultant or director roles do not themselves establish spokesperson service.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
